_comment: Logical-name -> checkpoint-stem mapping. Edit aliases to swap models without code changes. 'default' is used when neither an alias nor a direct file matches.
_hk_note: models/hk/lstm_v1.pth is a raw state_dict (input_dim=7, no DataPreparer metadata). It cannot be loaded by ModelManager without a wrapper. Retrain via trainer_v4_1.py with HK symbols to get a proper wrapped checkpoint, then update v3_hk_stocks alias below.
_hk_v2_note: HK prediction model V2 (HKAlpha-1) is NOT a .pth checkpoint and does not resolve through this registry. v3_pipeline/models/hk_predictor_v2.py discovers the newest guard-passing self_learn/models/hkalpha1_*.pkl via its JSON sidecar. Train via self_learn/scripts/train_hk_alpha.py.
